tasks.label: TurtleBot3: Launch Gazebo World
tasks.command: export TURTLEBOT3_MODEL=burger && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && ros2 launch turtlebot3_gazebo turtlebot3_world.launch.py

tasks.label: TurtleBot3: Launch Cartographer SLAM
tasks.command: export TURTLEBOT3_MODEL=burger && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && ros2 launch turtlebot3_cartographer cartographer.launch.py use_sim_time:=true

tasks.label: TurtleBot3: Launch Navigation2
tasks.command: export TURTLEBOT3_MODEL=burger && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && ros2 launch turtlebot3_navigation2 navigation2.launch.py map:=${input:mapFile} use_sim_time:=true

tasks.label: YOLO: Train Model
tasks.command: cd yolo_proj/yolov5 && source ../volov5/bin/activate && python train.py --img 640 --batch 16 --epochs 50 --data datasets/3class/data.yaml --weights yolov5s.pt --name gassib

tasks.label: YOLO: Detect (Webcam)
tasks.command: cd yolo_proj/yolov5 && source ../volov5/bin/activate && python detect.py --weights runs/train/gassib/weights/best.pt --source 0 --img 640 --data datasets/3class/data.yaml

tasks.label: YOLO: Detect (Images)
tasks.command: cd yolo_proj/yolov5 && source ../volov5/bin/activate && python detect.py --weights runs/train/gassib/weights/best.pt --source datasets/3class/valid/images --img 640 --data datasets/3class/data.yaml

tasks.label: Python: Install Requirements (YOLO)
tasks.command: cd yolo_proj && source volov5/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt

inputs.description: Output path for saved map (without extension)
